GetLookupFiles
Method.Implementation:
#dim tStat as %Status set itNum = 0 NEW $NAMESPACE SET $NAMESPACE = nmSp
&sql(Declare Cl Cursor for SELECT DISTINCT TableName into tb FROM Ens_Util.LookupTable) Set SQLCODE=0 &sql(OPEN Cl)
Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("GetLookupFiles select from Ens_Util.LookupTable, stat " _ SQLCODE)
WHILE(SQLCODE = 0) { &sql(FETCH Cl) Quit:SQLCODE set intNm = $NAMESPACE _ "." _ tb _ ".LOOKUP" Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("Routine:GetLookupFiles: " _ intNm _ " in namespace: " _ $NAMESPACE) set stat = ..AddToSourceControl(intNm, nmSp, 0) if ( stat '= $$$OK) { Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("Routine:GetLookupFiles: returned error") return 0 } set itNum = itNum + 1 } &sql(CLOSE Cl)
return itNum

Method.name: AddToSvn
Method.Implementation: set stat = 0 Set cmd = $$$SVNINFO _ " --username " _ usrNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' " _ fullPath Set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).ExecuteShellCmd( cmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("AddToSvn: " _ fullPath _ " svn info:" _ stat) If stat '= 0 { Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile( $$$SVNINFO _" returned no information, add to SVN" ) Set cmd = $$$SVNADD _ " --username " _ usrNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' " _ fullPath ; a non-recursive commit (-N) Set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).ExecuteShellCmd( cmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("AddToSvn: svn add:" _ stat) } if ((stat = 0) && (commit = 1)) { Set cmd = $$$SVNCOMMIT _ " --username " _ usrNm _ " --password '" _ passwd _ "' -m ""Initialization"" " _ fullPath ; a non-recursive commit Set stat = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).ExecuteShellCmd( cmd) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFile("AddToSvn: svn commit:" _ stat) } Quit stat
